text: Hara on laatinooɗo maayɗo -sabu keeferaaku e majjere e geddi- ado Alla Fewnude mo, Men Wuurnitiri mo gomɗinal e ganndal e ɗoftaare, on no fota e wonɗo e niɓe keeferaaku e majjere e geddi ; mo hattanaa yaltude e ɗum? Ko wano ɓee sirkooɓe ɗoo cuɗiniranaa non sirkugol ñaama jiibe wennja e hoore meere, heeferɓe ɓen kadi cuɗirinanaa kon ko ɓe woni yeddude ; fi no ɓe yoɓitiree ɗum lepte muusuɗe Ñalnde Darngal.
